channel.title: BoonHouse Publishing Blog
channel.description: Calm, evidence-based guidance for parents, and the books that go deeper.

item.title: Why Toddlers Have Tantrums: Beyond Manipulation to Emotional Overwhelm
item.description: Understand why toddlers have tantrums, moving past ideas of manipulation to recognize emotional overwhelm. Learn how to respond with calm presence.

item.title: The Power of Repair: Apologizing to Your Child After Yelling
item.description: Learn how to effectively apologize to your child after yelling and strengthen your bond. This guide provides a simple framework for genuine repair.

item.title: Beyond the Time-Out: Building a "Cool-Down" Corner
item.description: Learn how to build a cool-down corner for toddlers and older children, offering a safe, co-regulated space for big emotions instead of traditional time-outs.

item.title: Newborn Survival Guide: Your First Week Home from the Hospital
item.description: A newborn survival guide for the first week home from the hospital: what to expect with sleep, feeding, recovery, and when to call your doctor.

item.title: What to Say When Your Toddler Won't Listen: 10 Scripts That Actually Work
item.description: When your toddler won't listen, your words matter more than your volume. These 10 specific phrases reach toddlers when repeated requests keep failing.

item.title: French Parenting Phrases That Stop Tantrums: Why "Calm Down" Backfires and What to Say Instead
item.description: French parenting phrases that stop tantrums work by naming the emotion, not fighting it. Here's the science and the exact scripts to use.

item.title: Toddler Hits When Frustrated: How to Stop It Before Anyone Gets Hurt
item.description: When your toddler hits when frustrated, here's how to stop it: the mechanism, exact scripts, and what to practice between incidents.

item.title: My Toddler Bites When Angry: What to Do and Why the Bite Comes First
item.description: When your toddler bites when angry, here is what to do in the moment, why it happens, and the exact scripts to use every time.
